purpose: Conformance vectors for custody-ref-v1: typed, fail-closed pointer to a custody-domain assertion (same_domain / deployer_domain / independent_third_party). Includes the negative case where an independent_third_party claim is falsified by the capturer being the sole signer of the covered action_ref.

vectors.description: same_domain, valid: capturer_id and executor_id are the same operator identity (action_ref reused from signing-trust-ref str-001, operator_key case). Structural check: capturer_id == executor_id — satisfied.

paired_signing_trust_ref.note: cross-reference only, not part of the hashed preimage

vectors.description: deployer_domain, valid: capturer_id is the deployer domain hosting the agent, distinct from the agent's own key (action_ref reused from signing-trust-ref str-002, agent_keypair case). Structural check: capturer_id != executor_id — satisfied.

paired_signing_trust_ref.note: cross-reference only, not part of the hashed preimage

vectors.description: independent_third_party, valid: capturer_id (witness-01, an operationally separate ERC-8004 witness wallet) is neither the executor_id (TKCollective 2-of-3 threshold, action_ref reused from signing-trust-ref str-003) nor the signer_id that covers this action_ref. Structural check: capturer_id != executor_id AND capturer_id != paired signer_id — both satisfied, independence is real, not just labeled.

paired_signing_trust_ref.note: cross-reference only, not part of the hashed preimage

vectors.description: NEGATIVE — independent_third_party declared, but capturer_id equals the sole signer_id covering this action_ref (reused from signing-trust-ref str-001). executor_id was renamed to a distinct hosted-instance label so the naive capturer_id != executor_id check alone would look satisfied — but the deeper cross-check against signing_trust_ref shows capturer_id == signer_id: the only attestation in the system is the issuer's own. This is exactly the failure mode named in the task: a record that declares independent third party when only the issuer attests. A conformant validator MUST reject this vector despite a structurally-valid hash and a superficially-plausible capturer/executor split.
vectors.expect_reason: capturer_id equals the signer_id of the signing_trust_ref covering the same action_ref — independence is claimed but the only signer is the capturer itself

paired_signing_trust_ref.note: cross-reference only, not part of the hashed preimage
